in_sanskrit.name: Mangat
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Powerful, Victorious
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mangat एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit root 'man' (meaning 'to think') and 'gam' (meaning 'to go'), Mangat signifies one who has the power to go forward and think wisely. In Hindu mythology, Mangat is an epithet of the god Hanuman, symbolizing his strength, courage, and intelligence.
